page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.3xlarge is a storage-focused instance type featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB per core. A key hardware characteristic is the inclusion of 35,433 GB of local HDD storage, making it highly dense in terms of storage capacity. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 architecture with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the bottom 25% and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core capabilities are more robust, with stress-ng multi-core, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and PassMark CPU scores all landing in the average range. Memory bandwidth is also average, with uncached large-block reads and writes reaching 54.9 GB/sec and 47.08 GB/sec respectively, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.3xlarge is its reliance on high-capacity HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, which limits random I/O performance despite the massive 35.4 TB capacity. This makes the instance cost-efficient for sequential storage-heavy workloads rather than high-IOPS database operations. It is best suited for big data processing, log archiving, data warehousing, and large-scale sequential data storage where massive capacity is prioritized over low-latency disk access.
